add.name: transfer_exact
add.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (pre("balanceOf", sender) - post("balanceOf", sender) != arg(1) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) - pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) != arg(1))
add.why: transfer moves exactly amount from sender to recipient

add.name: delegate_total_exact
add.why: total delegated grows by exactly the delegated amount

add.name: balance_no_wrap
add.expr: ok and (called("delegate") or called("transfer")) and post("balanceOf", sender) > pre("balanceOf", sender)
add.why: spending or delegating never increases the caller's spendable balance (catches unchecked underflow)
